description: Make a team role on a board, or change one: named by 'role' (its name, any case, or id) — made when the board has none by that name. 'needsApproval': true makes a person who marks the role for themselves wait for an administrator's yes (for roles safety rests on — «Electrician»); false gives the role to everybody who was waiting. 'rename' gives an existing role a new name. Left out, either stays as it is. The board's owner and its administrators only. Answers with the role, its holders and who waits.

needsApproval.description: Whether a person marking it for themselves waits for an administrator's yes.

rename.description: A new name for an existing role.

role.description: The role's name, e.g. 'Электрик' (or its id, to change one).

name: set_team_role
title: Set team role
